name: sim_shimura_variety_canonical_model
description: Shimura variety canonical models via cvc5 constraint proofs and sympy CM verification

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG not needed; Shimura variety structure handled algebraically

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; arithmetic geometry via cvc5/sympy

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; algebraic geometry handled symbolically

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; no hypergraph structure

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic computations sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology required

test_valid_degree_bound.interpretation: Valid Shimura datum with reflex field degree = dim(X) + 1

test_cm_elliptic_galois_action.interpretation: CM elliptic curve E: y^2 = x^3 - x has Gal action via Hecke character

test_shimura_taniyama_formula.formula: χ_A(Frob_p) = characteristic root of T_p on H^1_et(A, Z_ℓ)
test_shimura_taniyama_formula.interpretation: Torsion point Galois action recoverable from Hecke eigenvalues

test_reflex_degree_overflow.interpretation: UNSAT: reflex field degree [E:Q]=5 > dim(X)+1=3 is structurally impossible

test_weight_non_central.interpretation: UNSAT: non-central weight homomorphism contradicts Shimura axiom

test_invalid_galois_action.claim: Gal(Q^ab/Q) action NOT via Hecke character
test_invalid_galois_action.consequence: l-adic cohomology representations fail to be compatible
test_invalid_galois_action.reason: Shimura-Taniyama theorem is a structural necessity, not a choice

test_minimal_shimura_datum.interpretation: Boundary: reflex field = Q is valid for 1-dimensional Shimura variety

test_locally_symmetric_decomposition.property: analytic space = disjoint union of locally symmetric spaces
test_locally_symmetric_decomposition.interpretation: Boundary: topological compactification preserves disjoint union structure

test_high_dimension_bound.interpretation: Boundary: degree bound scales linearly with dimension
